rules.rule: Urgent: RR-TB with urgent symptoms at routine visit
rules.problem: 'Give urgent attention and refer' justifies Urgent. Or-structure faithful. Hemoptysis volume threshold dropped; 'persistent episodes of coughing blood -> consider surgical referral' not encoded (minor).

summary: Rule 3 assigns Urgent priority to the admission-discussion box, whose heading is 'discuss or refer for admission', and omits Hb < 8. Several concepts are imprecise: Difficulty walking (broader than unable to walk unaided), Noncompliance (vs difficulty with adherence), unfinished-sentence proxy, and hemoptysis without the tablespoon threshold. No claim was unsupported; all citations trace to the page.
